input: Any commit that modifies /moves/bishop_f8.text, /moves/pawn_c7.text, /moves/pawn_g7.text, or /moves/bishop_c8.text (the agents that have already gone off plan) must carry valid signatures from at least fourteen different Black agents' keys in addition to the moving piece's own signature.
response: always(([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/$k.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/bishop_f8.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/pawn_c7.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/pawn_g7.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/bishop_c8.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false))
